data.name: Lord Wars
data.detailed_description:
Tired of wandering through blank fog of war to scout enemy positions in traditional medieval strategy games? Lord Wars completely abandons this outdated design, bringing a brand-new tactical experience built around terrain shelter and dynamic weather shifts.

You can always view the full layout of the battlefield map, yet you may never fully grasp your rival’s troop arrangements. Hide your army deep within woods and hills, then launch sudden flanking assaults and backdoor raids the moment rain, blizzard or thick mist descends. These ever-changing weather conditions will narrow sightlines and disrupt ranged combat, letting you turn clear sight disadvantage into a devastating surprise strike.

Build your manor settlement, gather resources to erect military facilities, and upgrade your barracks step by step to churn out seasoned veteran and elite troops directly. Multiple production buildings operate simultaneously to speed up army formation, carrying forward the classic fast-paced resource management and troop spawning fun of timeless RTS works.

Every unit has clear counter relationships, so pure numerical advantage cannot guarantee victory. Strike at enemy supply lines and production buildings to cut off their troop reinforcement, break their defensive choke points and seize the upper hand in battle. A strict population cap prevents endless mindless unit spamming and tedious late-game resource grinding.

No drawn-out stalemates will drag on for hours. Each match is designed to reach a decisive end within an hour. Outthink opponents with ambushes and environmental tricks rather than just outproduce them economically. Challenge cunning AI opponents in single-player skirmishes, or compete head-to-head with other players in online multiplayer to claim dominance over the medieval fiefdoms.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Win 10 11
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Win 10 11
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mild combat and unit death effects during battles, with no excessive bloody, gory, explicit violent or adult content.
